nppReachable.description:
True if the account can accept deposits via NPP. Does not check if the account is closed or has 
sanctions that may prevent deposits clearing.

accountServices.description:
List of NPP services that can be used to send to deposits to this account. eg x2p1- OSKO, 
sct- Single Credit Transfer.

validBsb.description: Whether the bsb provided in the parameter matches with the account attached to the PayID

validAccountNumber.description: Whether the accountNumber provided in the parameter matches with the account attached to the PayID

bic11.description:
The BIC11 of the bank where the account is held. Only provided when both `bsb` and `accountNumber` is 
provided in the parameters
